balls.text: GONE!! Bowled this time!! right on the money, yorker length, Harshal Patel tries to carve it through point but his off stump is pegged back by the time he manages to get his bat down on time
GONE!! Vinay kumar has played his part here!! full outside off, tries to smack it over the cover fielder but does not get the required elevation and Morne takes a regulation catch at covers
that was a mimic shot from Vinay kumar!! full toss on the stumps, takes it on the full and dumps it towards the fine leg region
AB De villers tries a reverse sweep but it goes one bounce to short third man
yorker length, crashes it past the bowler straight down the ground for a four, what a shot that was, well timed!
full toss outside off, slams it to long on, hop over for a single
on the off, slaps it to long-off for an easy single
Good length, Vinay Kumar loops it straight over the bowlers head, one bounce and the fielder cuts it off
outside off, drives it with bottom of the bat to long-off
outside off, smacks it on to the on side wide of backward square leg, ABD is turning it on here,
similar delivery, similar shot played, this time he does not time it well, off it runs away to the third man boundary
how on earth did he manage that!! high full toss outside off, goes for the reverse sweep, connects it well and it sails over the third man boundary, 50 to AB De Villiers
outside off, loops it into the air over mid wicket region, go through for an easy two
shortish, hits De Villers close to the helmet as he tries to pull it over midwicket, slighly scary
short outside off, looks to pull it but cant get the meat off the bat and it goes to the on side
fuller length , flicked it to deep square leg for an easy single
on the leg, just dabs it to the on side and go through for a single
Good length on the off, just a push and it went all the way to deep cover and they run two, tight ones though
on the full, that came out of nowhere, AB De Villiers goes down on one knee and paddle sweeps  it to fine leg boundary
short of a length, pulls it to backward square leg region and they hop for a single
leg stump line, pushes it straight to cover, tries to sneak a single but wisely sent back
on the leg stump again, AB De villiers tries to reverse sweep but hits his pads and rolls onto the on side
slower delivery down the leg stump, turns it off his hips, fielder at backward square cuts it off
starts with a slower delivery outside leg, tries to defend it but off it comes of his pads
slightly tossed up and in the slot asking to be smashed, he lofts it high over midwicket but the fielder at deep midwicket cuts it off
on the middle and leg, turns it on to the on side and pinches an easy single
full toss on the off stump, slaps it to deep cover
on the middle and leg, turns it to deep midwicket
on the stumps, tries to drive him through but back to the bowler
on the off, stays in the crease and steers it to covers for a single
pushes it through the air, solid defence on display from Vinay kumar
down the leg side again, flicks it to backward square for an easy single
short down the leg, plays it fine to the fine leg boundary, that was deftly played
outside off, pushes it to cover
Thats GONE!! deflects off the keeper to square leg and Bracewell picks and shoots it to Maxwell, well short of the crease
tossed up, steers it to deep midwicket for a single
on the leg stump, punches it between midwicket and long on
whattaaa shot!! stands tall in his crease and smacks it high over the long off fielder straight into the crowd
fuller length and punches it straight to mid-on,
short and well wide down the leg side
slower delivery, straight to the fielder at short cover
on the off, just pushes it to mid-on, no timing at all
on good length, chips it to backward square
on the leg stump, shuffles across a tad and glances it deftly to the fine leg boundary
on the full outside off, turns it to deep square leg
outside off, straight to sweeper cover
on the middle, pushes it to the bowler
GONE!! against the run of play, Mayank Agarwal has holed out here, plants his foot forward and tries to go downtown with that shot but it goes straight down the throat of Nagar at long-off
on the middle, crunches it to cover for no run
dangerous delivery, short, tries to evade the delivery but ends up getting a bat on it
slightly short, plays with soft hands and bunts it right in front of the short cover
on the off, punches it to point
thats disappeared, on the pads, too much pace, goes through with the shot, high over the midwicket region, into the crowd!
Half volley, looks to bludgeon it straight past the bowler but Morkel stops it
on the pads, looks to hit on the on side, but rolls off his pads
on good length, looks to cut it but misses it as the ball fizzes past him
short and wide, was asking to be hit and upper cuts it towards the wide third man region, one bounce over the fence
good length on the pads, flicks it to square leg for a single
plants his front foot forward and slams it with brute power but one bounce to the fielder at long off
outside off, punches it but straight to the fielder at point, no run
shortish length, lets it go through to the wicketkeeper
moves on to the off side, glances it to fine leg
outside leg, hits his pads straight into the wicket keepers gloves
stays in the crease and lofts it over to the long-off region
on the stumps, makes room and tries to cut it past the point fielder
on the legs, wristy flick to deep backward square
tossed up, makes room and smacks it over cover region for a two
on the leg stump, pushes it to midwicket and go through for a tight single, scamper home in time
on the off stump, plays with the spin, steers it to point region
on the full, pinches it to cover
on the off stump, rocks back and crunches it to deep point for an easy single
on the leg side, jams it back to the bowler
Gone!! given out LBW, Maxwell picks a wicket right off his first ball, a huge inside edge onto the pads, but the umpire gives him out without much thought
outside off, De villiers spears it through the off side but the man at deep cover cuts it off just in time
on the full, stays in the crease and jabs it back to the bowler
similar shot played, gets behind and punches it to deep midwicket for a single
outside off, gets behind and defends it solidly

wats going on here!! Kohli is gone!! pitched outside off, stays in the crease, takes it on the bounce and looks to slap it past the point fielder but it goes straight into the palms of Nagar, that's a big blow!!
on the off, he chops it straight to mid-off
moves away from the stumps, steers it to long-off for an easy single
Kohli had all the time in the world, width offered, moves away and smacks it to deep cover boundary
outside off, De villiers punches it through the covers for an easy single
outside off, steers it to point
on the middle, looks turn it on the on side, no run
on the legs, glances it to fine leg for an easy two

GONE!! slightly short of a length, McDonald looks to clear the midwicket region, takes a top edge and Doug Bracewell comes from nowhere and takes the catch one-handed just inches short of the ground!!
tries to go over the mid-on region but misses it completely, straight to the wicketkeeper
times it in the air and the ball goes flying wide of the man at mid-off, runs away to the boundary
Kohli looks to dump it over mid-on but one bounce to the fielder at mid-on
chops on to the pitch, rolls on to the slip cordon, no run
good length, punches it to mid-on for no run, he was eyeing the gap wide off mid on
on the leg stump, flicks it to square leg
awa
Dropped! a low full toss, Irfan pathan drops a sitter at mid-on, that should have been caught
Kohli at the crease, an inswinger, flicks it to deep backward square
on the pads, looks to turn it on the on side, hits it on the pads and rolls on to the on side
on the off, lets it go through to the keeper
he pulls a short one high into the air and an easy catch by Irfan at deep backward square, huge wicket!
GONE! big wicket, Pujara was looking dangerous
on the off side, pinches it to point, tees off for a single, but a 'no' says Pujara
slightly short, hooks it over the infield, fielder chases it while the batsmen go through for an easy two
on good length, jams it back to the bowler
skips down the track, keeps it simple, slams it straight over the bowler's head, umpire had to take cover
outside off, chips it straight to cover for no run
he's turning it on here, slaps it over covers for a boundary, what an over it turned out to be!!
this time he's smacks a Dorothy over long-on, on good length, stupendous shot right through the middle of the bat
2 in 2, dumped it this time through mid-on, exquisite timing!! sensational
BLASTED THAT, tries a yorker, comes as full toss, hammers it down through mid-off, nobody moved
swinging delivery, rocks back and pulls it to midwicket, no run
outside off, plays with soft hands to deep third man, easy single
away on the off, no run
swinging, between pad and bat
whatttaaa shot!! he's teed off here, picks it from off and slams it to sweeper cover, bludgeoned it
oh, nooo! catch dropped by Maxwell!! a few metres away from point but gets his left hand to it and drops it
full, drives it to man at cover, just a push
outside off, cuts it straight to third man
on the middle and off, straight to mid-off for an easy single
shortish, chips it to extra cover, sets off for a single but a wild throw fetch them an extra run
on the middle and leg, comes forward a bit and gets hit on the hips
well outside off, Pujara shoulders arms and watches it as it carries to the wicketkeeper
a bit of swing, flicks it to deep backward square for an easy single
outside off, inswinging delivery, McDonald lets it go to the wicketkeeper
that's it, game, set, match to RCB, Morne drives one to long off but that is only of academic interest to either of the teams!!
fuller length again, skips down the track and looks to spear it but misses it
pitched outside off, drags it to long on for one
outside off, manages to dig it out to long off
full and straight, drills it to deep mid wicket
full toss, smacks it high over the cover region, Pujara does well to get to the line of the ball but misses it, tough one indeed
GONE!! Run Out!! Pathan is Gone, flicks it off his legs to deep square leg, take a chance with the arm of Patel, AB De villiers does a good job as he removes the bails in a flash
angling into the batsman, Pathan skips down the track and tries to deposit that into the crowd but misses
yorker length, moves across and hits it past the bowler, only a single as they ponder over for a two since Kohli at deep mid off misfielded that
fuller again, opens the face of the blade and guides it to deep point
full toss again, mid off up in the circle, slaps it past the diving fielder at mid off
full toss, shuffles across, and swings it to deep mid wicket for a single
fuller length, slaps it one bounce to long off, just one run
right in the blockhole on the leg stump, looks to tuck it to the on side, gets only a single
full toss, gets behind and drives it to long on
slightly fuller, stands tall and thrashes it high over midwicket, one bounce over the fence
outside off, Bracewell looks to hit it out of Bangalore and misses it by a huge margin, does not connect at all
full on the legs, tries to dab it to midwicket, takes a leading edge and falls just short of the man at cover
GONE!! caught at backward point!! outside off, Nagar slashes it hard and tries to go over the backward point but to no avail
outside off, strikes it wide to backward point
leg stump line, thumps on his pads, rolls on to the leg side, AB De villiers picks the ball and throws it in a flash to Vettori but he does not collect it cleanly, batsmen pinch a single
on the full outside off, stays in the crease and carves it high over, one bounce to sweeper cover
on the legs, punches it to midwicket and hop over for a single
veers down the leg side, wide called
on the legs, turned away to square leg for a single
flat, pulled away to deep square leg
flatter again, this time Pathan goes over the midwicket region, timing written all over it
Massive!! flatter delivery, that comes off the meat off the bat, into the crowd at long off, that was humongous!!
leg stump line, sweeps it to short fine leg and go through for a single
flighted delivery outside off, bunts it to the off side
around the wicket, wide outside off, tries to heave it across the line but misses it by a big margin, AB De Villiers does not collect it cleanly, misses the helmet by a whisker
angling into the batsman as Nagar makes room, manages to top edge it wide of AB De Villiers who leaps into the air but it was quite wide
slower delivery, makes room, has all the time in the world and bludgeons it to the sweeper cover boundary, nobody moves!!
makes room and tries to swipe across the line and misses it
slower delivery, bounces over, Nagar watches as it goes past him in disbelief
in the slot, slams it off the toe end off the bat, one bounce to the man at wide long off
full toss on the leg stump, flicks it off his legs, short of the man at cover, Mayank Agarwal takes a shy at the stumps and misses
length ball, slaps it to deep midwicket for one

GONE!! caught by Mayank Agarwal, that was a blinder!! Venu hits it out of desperation, tries to go out downtown but Mayank Agarwal comes runnning from long off and takes a stunner just inches off the ground
well outside off, goes for the aerial shot high over to deep backward point
slower delivery, slightly short, tries to heave it over mid wicket but misses it again
outside off, Nagar comes forward and steers it to wide third man
short and angling into the batsman, similar shot, goes for the cut and misses again,
Similar delivery, Venu makes room and looks to cut it past point but misses it
good delivery, slightly short, and bounces, Venu swings and misses
leg stump line, tucks it to fine leg for a single
width offered, guides it intentionally to the third man for just a single, there were two on offer there
on the full, stays in the crease and crunches it to deep square leg for an easy two
on the leg side, looks to tuck it but gets hit on the pads
flighted delivery, zips past the outside edge of Nagar
GONE!! Caught by Zaheer at short fine leg!! down on one knee, does not pick the top spinner, tries to go over square leg but takes the leading edge and flies to Zak at short fine leg
slightly short, pulls it to deep midwicket
on the full again, punches it to long on and off they hop over for a single
on the full, swept to deep backward square leg, loops into the air
wide outside off, strikes it wide of sweeper cover
outside off, picks the gap and squeezes that to wide off long off for an easy two
fuller length, defends it solidly back to the bowler
fuller length, drives it to backward point, no run
uses his feet and tries to play it to the onside, inside edges on to the pads
outside off, tucks it to covers, no run
floating outside off, straight to keeper
GONE!! LBW!! on the full and spinning into the batsman, Finch is caught napping as he tries to flick it to the on side, that would have crashed into the middle and leg
pushed through the air, cuts it hard but one bounce and straight to the man at point
wide outside off, slices it to deep point for an easy single
on the leg side, tucks it on to the on side
spinning away from  the right hander, carves it on to the off side,
one more appeal and it was missing leg stump, thumps off his pads and goes to the on side
skidding through, Finch carves it to short third man for an easy single
on the off, punches it to mid wicket, plays it off his wrists
on the leg, dabs it to short fine leg
Huge appeal turned down and wisely so, it was going down the leg side
short and wide, goes back and pierces it through to the wide third man boundary
flat, shuffles across and turns it to square leg
slightly short, cut to deep backward point
tossed up, outside edge to short third third man for a single
GONE!! caught at slip!! flashes hard at that, takes a thick outside edge and flies straight to Kohli at first slip
on the middle and leg, pinches it to point for a single
drops it, that was tough though, slashes at it, takes the outside edge and flies off the gloves of AB De Villiers
on the leg stump, crunches it to deep midwicket
outside off, pushes it to covers
flashes at it it goes inches over the leaping McDonald at short third man, stops just short of the boundary
floating on the middle, slightly loops into the air but short of Vettori
outside off, cuts it straight to point
tossed up, steers it through to wide long off, a slight misfield fetches them a run
on the middle and leg, looks to hammer it over mid on but falls short of mid on, no run possible
low full toss, that comes off the splice of the bat and loops into the air towards deep midwicket
slower delivery outside off, tries to go over cover, takes a thick outside edge and flies to the wide third man boundary
a tad full, goes hard at it, no timing behind that shot, one bounce to the man at mid on who is on the edge of the circle
middle and leg, bunts it down to the right of mid on for an easy single
on the full, military medium, slaps it to mid on for no run
yorker length, digs it out well to the on side
in the slot to be hit, Ojha picks it up and clobbers it well over the mid on fielder, races away to the boundary
no width offered this time, lets it go through to the keeper
width offered, takes full advantage of it and smears it past the point fielder and the ball goes running away to the deep point fence
outside off, punches it hard but lands just short of the fielder at mid off, 6 dots in a row now
good length, rocks back and defends it back to the bowler
Vinay Kumar is keeping it tight here, cramps Finch for room here as he tries to slice it past point
similar delivery, straighter, defends solidly as the ball rolls back to the bowler
straighter, stays in the crease and jams it back to the bowler
on the good length, no room as Finch tries to cut it as the ball goes to the gully
slight inswing, tucks it with soft hands to the midwicket region
Straighter on the middle and leg, nudges it to fine leg
slower delivery on the legs, Finch plays it cautiously towards the mid wicket region
Good length, chops it onto his pads and pinch a  single
shortish length, looks to hook it over the square leg region but gets a top edge and loops into the air behind the wicket keeper
sprays it down the off side, quite wide, Ojha tries to poke at it
Good length delivery, stays in the crease and pushes it back to the bowler
pitched on the off, steers it straight to the point fielder
fuller length, tries to drive and gets an inside edge for no run
outside off, caught napping which he tries to poke
whattttaaa shot, into the crowd, can i have the ball back please? picks it from middle and leg and slams it right over the backward square leg boundary
some extra bounce, Ojha plays a deliberate upper cut over the leaping slip fielder to the third man boundary
peach of a delivery, seaming through the line, gets behind it and tries to defend it but to no avail
Good length, on the pads, Naman Ojha is all at sea with that delivery
outside off, inswinging, looks to chip it but misses it completely
outside off, cuts it to third man  for a single
GONE!!, outside off, cuts it hard but straight to the man at covers, That's a huge wicket, Sehwag is back in the hut
make that 3 in 3, outside off, rocks back and dumps it through the covers, he's turning it on here
2 in 2, similar delivery, this time steers it to deep cover region, what timing behind that shot!!
full toss outside off, opens the blade and guides it deep point for a four
